title: BookExport
description: One rendering of a book into a file somebody can hand over — a pdf, an epub, a docx. A pointer and a state, never the file: the bytes live in the store that rendered them, and this says which store, under which key, and whether it finished.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

book.description: The id of the book that was rendered, in the system that holds the book.

format.description: What was rendered. A pdf for reading on a screen and a pdf for a printer are two formats, not one: the page, the bleed and the margins differ.

status.description: How the rendering went. The file is only there to fetch once this says done.

file.description: The rendered file, where it is kept and how big it is. Absent until the rendering says done.

errorMessage.description: Why the rendering failed, in the words of whoever rendered it. Present only when it did.

createdAt.description: When the export was asked for, which is not when the file was ready.

completedAt.description: When the rendering finished, whether it succeeded or failed.
